concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Concept rounded dome useful but detached shoulder pieces too blade-like and regular. Build coherent rounded ellipsoidal granite body with only two broad curved asymmetric sheet patches, strongly conformal to shoulder with modest undercut gap, varying irregular edge shape/thickness. Core remains continuous beneath patches. No horizontal repeated tiers or scales.
